name: blindspot
description: A private locker for photos, videos and notes on Windows that AI agents, screenshots and screen shares can't see into.

scripts.build: electron-packager . Blindspot --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --icon=build/icon.ico --overwrite --ignore=^/dist --ignore=^/docs --ignore=^/build --ignore=test.js && electron-fuses write --app dist/Blindspot-win32-x64/Blindspot.exe RunAsNode=off EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable=off EnableNodeCliInspectArguments=off
